# polymaze-website

> Website of POLYMAZE, a robotics competition: design and build a robot to conquer a complex maze. Pages for the competition, about us, participation, FAQ, testimonies and team registration. Live at https://polymaze.vic-enp.com. Next.js, Three.js, Supabase.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://github.com/puIad/polymaze-website/blob/main/README.md): what the site is, stack and how to run it

## Source

- [src/app/register](https://github.com/puIad/polymaze-website/tree/main/src/app/register): team registration
- [src/app/faq](https://github.com/puIad/polymaze-website/tree/main/src/app/faq): FAQ
- [src/app/participate](https://github.com/puIad/polymaze-website/tree/main/src/app/participate): how to participate
- [src/app/components](https://github.com/puIad/polymaze-website/tree/main/src/app/components): shared components
